regions.text: 然堂（C）とは現實性の側にあって矛盾對當し、必然性は實在性の傾域に、偶然性は歳無性の領域に屬す。

quote.translation: Necessity (N) and contingency (C) stand in contradictory opposition on the side of actuality, necessity belonging to the domain of reality and contingency to the domain of nihility.

regions.text: 那能（P）と不取能地（了）とは非現實性の側にあつて矛盾勢當し可能性は實在性の傾域に不可能性は虛無性の領域に届す。

quote.translation: Possibility (P) and impossibility (I) stand in contradictory opposition on the side of non-actuality, possibility belonging to the domain of reality and impossibility to the domain of nihility.

regions.text: 四第二體系。横線の上下は現賞性（R乏剃現御他R）とを表はす。左右の對立に矛盾對當の闘係が現はれてゐる。

quote.translation: Here what lies above and below the horizontal line represents actuality (R) and non-actuality (R′), and the relation of contradictory opposition appears in the opposition of left and right.

regions.text: 但し、現實性の範関内にあつては、左方は實在性（+）を、右方は盛無性（一）を表はし、非現賞性の範閣内にあつては、その反對に、左方は慮無性を右方は實在性を表はす。

quote.translation: Within the range of actuality, however, the left side represents reality (`+`) and the right side nihility (`-`), whereas within the range of non-actuality the reverse holds, the left side representing nihility and the right side reality.

regions.text: 必然堂N）と不か能堂了）とは反對々置をなし、側然地（C）と可地地（P）とは小反對々當をなす。

quote.translation: Necessity (N) and impossibility (I) form a contrary opposition, and contingency (C) and possibility (P) a subcontrary opposition; the large circle of contrary opposition represents apodicticity, and the small circle of subcontrary opposition represents problematicity.

regions.text: 反對々賞の大園は確避性を表はし、小反對々當の小画は間題性を表はす。
四第三體系。国の中心より左方は實在性（さ）を表はし右方は虚無性（こを表はす。

quote.translation: Measured from the centre of the circle, the left side represents reality (`+`) and the right side nihility (`-`), whilst the part above the horizontal line represents actuality (R) and the part below it non-actuality (R′).

regions.text: 機線の上部は現賞性（R）を下部は珈珈電R）を表はす。必然桃（N）の大圓は加能惻（P）の小圓を包機して、實在性の頷域に於て大小對賞をなし不取能性T）の大圓は側然地C）の小国を包議して慮無性の頑域に於て大小對當をなす。

quote.translation: The large circle of necessity (N) subsumes the small circle of possibility (P), the two forming a subalternation in the domain of reality, and the large circle of impossibility (I) subsumes the small circle of contingency (C), the two forming a subalternation in the domain of nihility.

regions.text: 必然性と偶然性とは現實性の範岡内に於て矛盾對営をなすものであるから非現質

quote.translation: Since necessity and contingency form a contradictory opposition within the range of actuality, the large circle of necessity and the small circle of contingency are drawn in dotted lines in the range of non-actuality, that is, in the part below the horizontal line, to show that they do not belong there.
